name: agent-workspace
description: Create isolated development workspaces, verify and build projects, run web prototypes, and inspect results through a remote MCP service.

interface.longDescription: Create isolated workspaces for uploaded projects, verify and build npm or Maven applications, run temporary web prototypes, capture screenshots, and hand off build artifacts to other services.
defaultPrompt: Verify and build this project in an isolated workspace.
Run this web prototype and show me a screenshot.
Build this project and give me a downloadable artifact.
